key_concepts: All matter is made of atoms
Atoms are the smallest unit of matter that retains the identity of a substance
Atoms consist of protons, neutrons, and electrons
Protons are positively charged and located in the nucleus
Neutrons have no charge and are located in the nucleus
Electrons are negatively charged and located outside the nucleus
Neutral atoms have equal numbers of protons and electrons
Atomic number equals the number of protons and, in neutral atoms, the number of electrons
Mass number is the sum of protons and neutrons, so neutrons equal mass number minus atomic
Ions form when atoms gain or lose electrons; anions gain electrons and cations lose electr
Thomson's plum pudding model compares the atom to a watermelon with embedded electrons
Basal fertilizer elements nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium have specific proton, electr
